blurb: Guests parasail at heights of 400, 600, or 800 feet over the ocean or bay. Flights last about 12 minutes of air time with a total experience time of 1 hour 15 minutes. The company is family-owned with over 75 years of combined experience and has completed over 400,000 flights since 1984.
extraNote: Gift voucher sales are final and non-refundable. · No-shows are nonrefundable, or will be charged the full price if not already paid. · Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · Arrive 15 minutes prior to reservation · We're looking forward to seeing you! Please note... Uptown location (54th St) has free parking at Macky's restaurant. Downtown location (Talbot St) is street parking only. Please arrive 20 minutes ahead of time, to help ensure the boat departs on time! Crew works for tips - cash is appreciated!
